comment: Sanctioned upward-closure violations. Each entry suppresses exactly the listed missing items at the named site; when the repair lands the entry goes stale and fails the gate until removed. 'pending' names the worktree branch that owns the fix; 'evidence' documents why the set is deliberately not upward-closed.

exceptions.reason: The 5.3.02 editor-model record carries seven fewer aliases than the 5.3.01 and 5.3.03 records: the same morph-target/part selectors are declared on '5.0.00-5.3.01,5.3.03-5.3.04' in compatibility/cubism/verification-src/editor-model.json, so 5.3.02 is the only gap in the 5.3 line.
exceptions.evidence: Not backfillable from repository data, checked alias by alias against the 5.3.02 observation source: compatibility/cubism/mapping-packs/draft/cubism-5.3.02-editor-model-read.json (source=exact-public-classfile-observation, status=DRAFT, 1130 entries) carries no entry for KeyFormMorphTargetSet.remove(KeyFormMorphTarget)V, KeyFormMorphTarget.setParameter(CParameterGuid)V, KeyFormMorphTarget.setParameterAndKeyValue(CParameterGuid,Float)V, ACParameterControllableSource.internal_setParent(CPartSource)V, CParameterGroup.getGuid()CParameterGroupGuid, CPartSource.removeChild(ACParameterControllableSource)V, or CPart.getId()CPartId. Its only getId()CPartId observation is on CPartSource, so the CPart.id alias has no 5.3.02 member either. Backfilling would assert unverified internal member names for the exact 5.3.02 artifact; no reviewed 5.3.02 jar is available offline to re-verify them, so the gap stays an explicit exception. cubism.editor-model.morph-target-set.create-undo was removed from this list: 5.3.02 carries it through cubism.mapping.v5_3_02.editor_model.method.morph_target_set_create_undo, so it was never missing.

exceptions.reason: The three CUBISM_VERSION_* constants look like an admission set but are only slice-id dispatch keys.
exceptions.evidence: authorizes(resolver) admits every ReviewedHostArtifacts.reviewedCubismVersions() entry; the constants merely pick adapter-slice ids, so no reviewed version is refused.

exceptions.reason: artifactProfile's case arms look like a version set.
exceptions.evidence: The switch is an identity mapping: 'default -> reviewedVersion' passes every admitted version through unchanged; the two case arms exist only as the single place a profile-id divergence would live.

Property-gated validation diagnostic (turboism.validation.editorTextureReplaceDiagnostic) that was authored and reviewed against the exact 5.3.02 host; it is a diagnostic tool, not a capability admission set.

exceptions.reason: A single-version CUBISM_5_3_03.equals(artifact) guard looks like admission.
exceptions.evidence: The guard only selects the optional 5.3.03 validation-candidate runtime scope (admits5303ValidationCandidate); every reviewed artifact still gets a resolver with a null extra scope.
The final branch admits every ReviewedHostArtifacts.reviewedCubismVersions() entry and returns the generic cubism5203() targets; the two named arms are fast paths, not an admission set.
